KEARNEY, Neb.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--The Buckle, Inc. (NYSE: BKE) announced today that net income for the fiscal quarter ended October 31, 2026 was $48.0 million, or $0.95 per share ($0.94 per share on a diluted basis).

Net sales for the 13-week fiscal quarter ended October 31, 2026 increased 2.6 percent to $329.2 million from net sales of $320.8 million for the prior year 13-week fiscal quarter ended November 1, 2025. Comparable store net sales for the 13-week fiscal quarter ended October 31, 2026 increased 0.6 percent from comparable store net sales for the prior year 13-week period ended November 1, 2025. Online sales decreased 1.4 percent to $52.2 million for the 13-week fiscal quarter ended October 31, 2026, compared to net sales of $53.0 million for the 13-week fiscal quarter ended November 1, 2025.

Net sales for the 39-week fiscal period ended October 31, 2026 increased 4.3 percent to $937.8 million from net sales of $898.7 million for the prior year 39-week fiscal period ended November 1, 2025. Comparable store net sales for the 39-week period ended October 31, 2026 increased 2.5 percent from comparable store net sales for the prior year 39-week period ended November 1, 2025. Online sales increased 1.1 percent to $144.5 million for the 39-week period ended October 31, 2026, compared to net sales of $142.9 million for the 39-week period ended November 1, 2025.

Net income for the third quarter of fiscal 2026 was $48.0 million, or $0.95 per share ($0.94 per share on a diluted basis), compared with net income of $48.7 million, or $0.97 per share ($0.96 per share on a diluted basis) for the third quarter of fiscal 2025.

Net income for the 39-week fiscal period ended October 31, 2026 was $139.3 million, or $2.75 per share ($2.73 per share on a diluted basis), compared with net income of $128.9 million, or $2.57 per share ($2.55 per share on a diluted basis) for the 39-week period ended November 1, 2025.

Management will hold a live audio webcast at 10:00 a.m. EST today to discuss results for the quarter. To register for the live event, please visit https://buckle.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_iZVFy_StRI2AfMWfqKCqkg. A replay of the event can be accessed through Buckle’s investor relations website within twenty-four hours after the conclusion of the live event (https://corporate.buckle.com/investor-relations/events).

About Buckle

Buckle is a specialty retailer focused on delivering exceptional service and style through unforgettable experiences. Offering a curated mix of high-quality, on-trend apparel, accessories, and footwear, Buckle is for those living the styled life. Known as a denim destination, each store carries a wide selection of fits, styles, and finishes from leading denim brands, including the Company’s exclusive brand, BKE. Headquartered in Kearney, Nebraska, Buckle currently operates 452 retail stores in 42 states, which includes the opening of two new stores located in Round Rock, Texas and Elizabethtown, Kentucky in fiscal November (after the fiscal quarter ended). As of the end of the fiscal quarter, it operated 450 stores in 42 states compared with 442 stores in 42 states at the end of the third quarter of fiscal 2025.

ERAS-0015 at 32 mg QD achieved 44% confirmed ORR in 2L+ KRAS G12X PDAC, despite heavy pretreatment (84% in the 3L+ setting) and a high proportion of G12R mutations (44% of patients)

ERAS-0015 at 32 mg QD achieved 69% confirmed ORR in 2L+ KRAS G12D or G12V PDAC

ERAS-0015 at 32 mg QD achieved 60% confirmed ORR in post-ICI/platinum (2L/3L) KRAS G12X NSCLC

ERAS-0015 at 32 mg QD continued to be generally well tolerated, with mostly low-grade TRAEs and low rates of dose interruptions, reductions, and discontinuations

Early combination data with gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel, pembrolizumab, and panitumumab support ERAS-0015’s combination backbone potential

ERAS-4001 showed preliminary Phase 1 antitumor activity, favorable tolerability, and encouraging PK; dose escalation of the ERAS-0015 + ERAS-4001 combination expected to initiate in 2027

Conference call and live webcast today at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time

SAN DIEGO, Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Erasca, Inc. (Nasdaq: ERAS), a clinical-stage precision oncology company singularly focused on discovering, developing, and commercializing therapies for patients with RAS/MAPK pathway-driven cancers, today announced positive updated U.S. Phase 1 monotherapy and initial combination data reinforcing the best-in-class potential of pan-RAS molecular glue ERAS-0015 in patients with RAS-mutant solid tumors. The Company confirms its plans to initiate a potentially registration-enabling trial in 2L+ lung cancer in the first half of 2027 and a Phase 3 trial in 1L lung cancer in the second half of 2027 to first half of 2028 timeframe; and is accelerating the planned initiation of a Phase 3 trial in 1L pancreatic cancer to the first half of 2027. The Company also announced encouraging initial U.S. Phase 1 monotherapy data for potential first-in-class pan-KRAS inhibitor ERAS-4001, supporting its combination potential with ERAS-0015.

"These compelling results highlight the strength and breadth of ERAS-0015’s clinical activity across several tumor types," said Jonathan E. Lim, M.D., Erasca’s chairman, CEO, and co-founder. “We are particularly encouraged by confirmed responses in common KRAS mutation subtypes, including G12D and G12V, which together occur in nearly 70% of patients with pancreatic cancer. Importantly, we believe the robust clinical activity observed in this heavily pretreated population, which included a high proportion of patients whose tumors harbored less sensitive mutations, compares favorably with reported activity for other pan-RAS and mutant-selective inhibitors, subject to the limitations of cross-study comparisons. Additionally, we believe these efficacy results, coupled with generally well-tolerated safety data and low rates of dose interruptions, reductions, and discontinuations at 32 mg once daily, support advancing ERAS-0015 toward multiple potentially registration-enabling trials."

Dr. Lim continued, “Early combination data demonstrating favorable tolerability results with chemotherapy, an immune checkpoint inhibitor, and an anti-EGFR antibody, together with preliminary clinical activity for ERAS-4001, strengthen our rationale for expanding ERAS-0015’s combination potential. We expect 2027 to be an important year for our RAS-targeting franchise as we plan to initiate potentially registration-enabling clinical trials in pancreatic and lung cancers and advance combination dose-escalation trials, including the planned ERAS-0015 plus ERAS-4001 combination.”

Key U.S. Phase 1 interim results for ERAS-0015 (AURORAS-1):

As of the data cutoff date, ERAS-0015 monotherapy at the pharmacologically active doses (PAD) of 16-32 mg once daily (QD) (N=122) was generally well-tolerated with favorable safety data, and demonstrated encouraging activity in key KRAS G12X tumors. Monotherapy responses shown are confirmed. All patients with responses at 32 mg QD in all tumor types remained on treatment.1,2

ERAS-0015 Monotherapy Showed Strong Anti-Tumor Activity Across Advanced KRAS-Mutant Cancers

  • KRAS G12X pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) at 32 mg QD in the second-line or greater (2L+) setting1,2
    • 44% confirmed objective response rate (ORR) across all patients (N=25) with KRAS G12X mutations; 84% were treated in the third-line or later (3L+) setting and 44% had G12R mutations
    • 69% confirmed ORR in patients (N=13) with KRAS G12D or G12V PDAC, which represent nearly 70% of patients with PDAC. Of these patients, 77% were treated in 3L+

      • 63% confirmed ORR (N=8) in patients with KRAS G12D
      • 80% confirmed ORR (N=5) in patients with KRAS G12V
    • All (11 of 11) patients with confirmed responses and 6 of 11 patients with stable disease remained on treatment
  • KRAS G12X non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC)1,2
    • 60% confirmed ORR (N=5) at 32 mg QD and 58% confirmed ORR (N=12) across the PAD range of 16-32 mg QD in the 2L or 3L setting following an immune checkpoint inhibitor and platinum-based chemotherapy (post-ICI/platinum)
    • Activity was observed across multiple KRAS mutation subtypes at 32 mg QD in the 2L+ setting:

      • 60% confirmed ORR (N=5) in patients with KRAS G12D mutations
      • 50% confirmed ORR (N=4) in patients with KRAS G12V mutations
    • At 32 mg QD in the 2L+ setting, all (5 of 5) patients with confirmed responses and all (5 of 5) patients with stable disease remained on treatment
  • KRAS G12X biliary tract cancer (BTC) at 32 mg QD in the 1L+ setting1
    • 75% confirmed ORR (N=4)
    • All (3 of 3) patients with confirmed responses remained on treatment

ERAS-0015 Monotherapy Continued to Be Generally Well-Tolerated with Favorable Safety Data in Expanded Patient Population1,5

  • Frequency and severity of treatment-related adverse events (TRAEs) remained consistent with the Company’s April and July 2026 interim data disclosures
  • Mostly low-grade TRAEs with no dose-limiting toxicities (DLTs) and low rate of dose interruptions, reductions, and discontinuations due to TRAEs
    • At 32 mg QD (N=54), TRAEs led to dose interruptions in 13.0% of patients and dose reductions in 16.7% of patients, and there were no dose discontinuations (0% of patients)
  • 100% median relative dose intensity (RDI) at 32 mg QD

Early ERAS-0015 Combination Data Support Further Development and Potential for Differentiation with Standard-of-Care Therapies3

  • ERAS-0015 plus gemcitabine + nab-paclitaxel (Days 1 and 15):
    • Generally well tolerated with favorable safety data and no unexpected safety signals
    • The DLT window was cleared through the 16 mg QD ERAS-0015 cohort with no DLTs
    • Currently dosing the 24 mg QD ERAS-0015 dose escalation cohort
    • Efficacy data not yet available
    • Clinical data support further development in 1L PDAC
  • ERAS-0015 plus pembrolizumab:
    • Generally well tolerated with favorable safety data and no unexpected safety signals
    • The DLT window was cleared through the 32 mg QD ERAS-0015 cohort with no DLTs
    • Multiple responses observed in multiple solid tumor types in dose escalation
    • Clinical data support further development in 1L NSCLC, including combination with carboplatin/pemetrexed/pembrolizumab (initiated in Q4)
  • ERAS-0015 plus panitumumab:
    • 16 mg QD ERAS-0015 was generally well tolerated with favorable safety data and no unexpected safety signals
    • Multiple responses were observed in dose escalation in patients with KRAS G12X colorectal cancer (CRC), including 2 ongoing confirmed partial responses (PR) in 2 patients treated at 24 mg QD who then dose reduced to 16 mg QD, and 1 unconfirmed PR (uPR) in 4 patients treated at 16 mg QD
    • Combination dose exploration ongoing; plan to make dose selection in 2027

Encouraging Preliminary ERAS-4001 Phase 1 Data Support Planned Combination with ERAS-00154

  • Favorable safety and tolerability data with predominantly low-grade adverse events and no TRAEs leading to treatment discontinuation
  • Pharmacokinetic (PK) results were encouraging and support continued dose escalation
  • Preliminary monotherapy antitumor activity supports ERAS-4001’s potential as a combination partner for ERAS-0015
  • Nonclinical data demonstrated that the combination of ERAS-0015 and ERAS-4001 targets both active- and inactive-state KRAS and exhibits synergistic activity in KRAS G12X-driven models, providing a rationale for further evaluation of this combination

Key Anticipated Milestones

ERAS-0015: AURORAS-1 and Phase 3 Trials

  • Potentially registration-enabling trial in patients with 2L+ RAS-mutant NSCLC expected to initiate in the first half of 2027
  • Phase 3 trial in patients with 1L PDAC accelerated to initiate in the first half of 2027
  • Phase 3 trial in patients with 1L RAS-mutant NSCLC expected to initiate in the second half of 2027 to the first half of 2028
  • Combination dose escalation and expansion data expected in 2027

ERAS-4001: BOREALIS-1 Trial

  • Initiation of combination dose escalation trial with ERAS-0015 planned for 2027

² Includes responses confirmed after the data cutoff date
3 DCO October 14, 2026

5 As disclosed by the Company in April 2026, one Grade 3 TRAE of pneumonitis progressed to Grade 5 after withdrawal of supportive care per patient decision. The patient was a 66 year-old male with heavily pretreated metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma who received 24 mg of ERAS-0015. The patient had pulmonary metastases, a history of right lung cryoablation and no history of lung radiation. The patient presented to the ER approximately a month after starting ERAS-0015 with Grade 3 pneumonitis that was treated aggressively with immediate discontinuation of ERAS-0015, high dose steroids and infliximab. The patient requested withdrawal of supportive care and ultimately died of the event. No additional Grade 5 TRAEs have occurred

Erasca will hold a virtual investor event today, Friday, November 20, 2026 at 8:00 a.m. Eastern Time. To register for the event please click here. The live webcast and replay may be accessed by referring to Erasca’s website at Erasca.com/events.

About ERAS-0015
ERAS-0015 is an investigational, oral, highly potent pan-RAS molecular glue designed to inhibit RAS signaling with a potential best-in-class profile and has received Fast Track Designation (FTD) from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for the treatment of patients with metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma. The ongoing AURORAS-1 Phase 1 trial is evaluating ERAS-0015 as a monotherapy and in combination with other therapies in patients with RAS-mutant solid tumors. Clinical data have demonstrated robust monotherapy activity in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) and KRAS-mutant non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), and encouraging initial activity in KRAS-mutant colorectal cancer (CRC) in combination with an anti-EGFR antibody. ERAS-0015 has been generally well-tolerated with favorable safety data and with well-behaved pharmacokinetics (PK). Emerging tolerability data with chemotherapy, pembrolizumab, and panitumumab support combination development at ERAS-0015 doses within the pharmacologically active dose (PAD) range. ERAS-0015 is also designed to inhibit RAS wildtype variants, which may contribute to resistance to mutant-selective approaches. Together, these findings support its potential as both a monotherapy and backbone for combination regimens. 

About ERAS-4001
ERAS-4001 is an investigational, oral, highly potent, and selective pan-KRAS inhibitor with a potential first-in-class and best-in-class profile. Erasca is evaluating ERAS-4001 in the BOREALIS-1 Phase 1 trial in patients with KRAS-mutant solid tumors. Preliminary clinical data have demonstrated favorable safety and tolerability across doses evaluated. Promising preliminary pharmacokinetic (PK) data have been observed. In nonclinical studies, ERAS-4001 showed potent activity against both guanosine triphosphate (GTP)-bound (active state) and GDP-bound (inactive state) KRAS and induced tumor regression in multiple KRAS-mutant models. ERAS-4001 also inhibited wildtype KRAS, which may contribute to resistance to mutant-selective approaches, while sparing wildtype HRAS and NRAS. Preliminary monotherapy antitumor activity supports ERAS-4001’s potential as a combination partner for ERAS-0015.

About Erasca
At Erasca, our name is our mission: To erase cancer. We are a clinical-stage precision oncology company singularly focused on discovering, developing, and commercializing therapies for patients with RAS/MAPK pathway-driven cancers. Our company was co-founded by leading pioneers in precision oncology and RAS targeting to create novel therapies and combination regimens designed to comprehensively shut down the RAS/MAPK pathway for the treatment of patients with cancer. We believe our team’s capabilities and experience, further guided by our scientific advisory board which includes the world’s leading experts in the RAS/MAPK pathway, uniquely position us to achieve our bold mission of erasing cancer.

Former Goldman Sachs Chief Risk Officer brings extensive financial services, risk management, and regulatory expertise

SAN JOSE, Calif., Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- PayPal Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: PYPL) today announced that Brian J. Lee will join the company's Board of Directors as of November 30, 2026.

Lee brings more than three decades of experience in financial services, including serving as Chief Risk Officer at Goldman Sachs, where he developed deep expertise in enterprise risk management, financial oversight, regulatory capital, and corporate governance.

"Brian's extensive experience overseeing risk at one of the world's leading financial institutions makes him an outstanding addition to our Board," said David Dorman, Chair of PayPal's Board of Directors. "His financial acumen, understanding of complex global financial institutions and commitment to strong governance will provide important perspective as we continue to advance PayPal's long-term strategy and deliver value for our shareholders."

"PayPal is at an important inflection point as we sharpen our focus on financial services, strengthen our businesses, and reimagine how we serve consumers and merchants," said Enrique Lores, President and CEO of PayPal. "Brian's perspective on the evolving financial services landscape will be valuable as we execute our three-year strategy and deliver on the commitments we've made to our customers and shareholders."

"I'm honored to join PayPal's Board of Directors as the company enters its next chapter," said Lee. "PayPal serves as a financial partner that customers trust, connecting hundreds of millions of consumers and merchants through its payments platform. I look forward to working with Enrique, David, and my fellow directors to support the company's strategy, strengthen its competitive position and drive long-term value creation."

Lee joined Goldman Sachs in 1994 and has held numerous senior leadership positions at the firm. Most recently, he served as Chairman of its Risk Council from 2025 to October 2026, following his role as Chief Risk Officer from 2019 to January 2025. Previously, he served as Controller and Chief Accounting Officer from 2017 to 2019, overseeing financial reporting, product control, and regulatory capital. He was named Managing Director in 2002 and Partner in 2008. Prior to Goldman Sachs, Lee worked at Price Waterhouse. He also serves on the Board of Directors of KKR & Co. Inc.

Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling and shopping simple, personalized and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. BEDFORD, Mass., Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Ocular Therapeutix, Inc. (NASDAQ: OCUL, “Ocular” or the “Company”), an integrated biopharmaceutical company committed to redefining the retina experience, today announced that it has granted inducement awards to Ms. Tiffany Howard, the Company’s new Executive Vice President, Commercial – Retina. The awards were made as an inducement material to the recipient’s acceptance of employment with Ocular under Ocular’s 2019 Inducement Stock Incentive Plan in accordance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4).

The inducement equity awards were granted effective as of November 16, 2026, and consist of a non-statutory stock option award to purchase up to 200,000 shares of Ocular’s common stock and a restricted stock unit award representing the right to receive 65,000 shares of Ocular’s common stock. The stock option award has an exercise price of $6.01 per share, equal to the closing price of Ocular’s common stock on The Nasdaq Global Market on the effective date of grant. The stock option award has a ten-year term and vests over four years, with 25% of the original number of shares subject to the award vesting on the one-year anniversary of the date of grant, and the remainder vesting in equal monthly installments over the three years after such date, subject to the recipient’s continued service to Ocular through the applicable vesting dates. The restricted stock unit award vests over three years, in equal annual installments on the first, second and third anniversaries of the date of grant, subject to the recipient’s continued service to Ocular through the applicable vesting dates.

The inducement equity awards are subject to the terms and conditions of the award agreements covering the grants and Ocular’s 2019 Inducement Stock Incentive Plan.

About Ocular Therapeutix, Inc.
Ocular Therapeutix, Inc. is an integrated biopharmaceutical company committed to redefining the retina experience. AXPAXLI™ (also known as OTX-TKI), Ocular’s investigational product candidate for retinal disease, is an axitinib intravitreal hydrogel based on its ELUTYX™ proprietary bioresorbable hydrogel-based formulation technology. AXPAXLI is currently in Phase 3 clinical trials for wet age-related macular degeneration (wet AMD), and diabetic retinal disease, including non-proliferative diabetic retinopathy (NPDR). Ocular’s pipeline also leverages the ELUTYX technology in its commercial product DEXTENZA®, an FDA-approved corticosteroid for the treatment of ocular inflammation and pain following ophthalmic surgery in adults and pediatric patients and ocular itching associated with allergic conjunctivitis in adults and pediatric patients aged two years or older, and in its investigational product candidate OTX-TIC, which is a travoprost intracameral hydrogel that has completed a Phase 2 clinical trial for the treatment of open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension. Ocular is currently evaluating next steps for the OTX-TIC program.

Frontier Minerals consortium to enter exclusive negotiations with Government of Kenya for prospecting licence for Mrima Hill, one of the world’s largest and highest grade rare earth projects,¹ and concurrently pursue potential non-dilutive funding including U.S. Government grant support.

KELLOGG, Idaho, Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Bunker Hill Silver Corp. ("Bunker Hill" or the "Company") (TSX: BNKR | OTCQB: BHLL) is pleased to announce that Frontier Minerals LLC ("Frontier"), a U.S.-led consortium which includes Bunker Hill alongside ReElement Technologies Corporation ("ReElement") and American Resources Corporation (“American Resources”) (NASDAQ: AREC), has received notification from the Government of Kenya's Ministry of Mining, Blue Economy and Maritime Affairs (the "Ministry") that it is the successful bidder in the international tender for the exclusive right to negotiate a prospecting licence for the Mrima Hill Rare Earth and Niobium Project in Kwale County, Kenya ("Mrima Hill" or the "Project"). The Cabinet Secretary for Mining, Blue Economy and Maritime Affairs announced the outcome of the tender on November 19, 2026.

Frontier is partnered with Bunker Hill, ReElement and American Resources, bringing together complementary expertise in mineral resource development, critical minerals supply chains and advanced refining technologies. Bunker Hill and the other consortium partners are expected to hold equity interests in Frontier, with the specific terms of the joint venture to be set forth in definitive agreements. Frontier is also pursuing U.S. government funding through the U.S. Department of State’s U.S.-Africa Strategic Investment Program for Project support. Subject to confirmation in definitive agreements, Bunker Hill does not anticipate a material cash outlay from the Company in the near-term or throughout the Mrima Hill feasibility study completion.

Mrima Hill is the first mining project in Kenya to be offered through an open and competitive international tender. Frontier's proposal combines Bunker Hill's mine-building and operating capability, as the consortium's mining and processing partner, with the innovative American refining capabilities and rare earth and critical minerals supply chain relationships contributed by ReElement and American Resources, a model designed to deliver separated rare earth and niobium products refined in Kenya for Western supply chains.

Under the proposed development plan submitted through the tender process, and if the consortium is ultimately awarded a prospecting licence for the Project, Bunker Hill will lead exploration and resource definition, metallurgical test work, process development and the feasibility study, which it will manage. Bunker Hill is also positioned to be contracted by the consortium to build and operate the mine and processing plant for Frontier in accordance with the results of the feasibility study. To maintain the Bunker Hill Mine team’s focus on the commissioning of the Bunker Hill operations in Idaho, the Project exploration, feasibility study, development and operations will be overseen and managed by a dedicated team assembled specifically for Mrima Hill in Kenya.

Bunker Hill will host a conference call and webcast on Monday, November 23, 2026, at 10:00 am Eastern Time. Details are provided below.

Highlights

  • Capital light participation: Bunker Hill expects to hold an equity interest in Frontier, subject to definitive agreements. The Frontier consortium is pursuing potential U.S. government financing for the Project and Bunker Hill does not expect to be required to make material cash contributions through completion of a feasibility study. Subject to confirmation through definitive agreements among the consortium partners, Bunker Hill expects to maintain the right but not the obligation to fund Project development.
  • World-scale, two-metal deposit: Historical 2013 NI 43-101 estimates of 48.7 Mt Indicated at 4.40% Total Rare Earth Oxides (TREO) and 110.7 Mt Inferred at 3.61% TREO (1.0% TREO cut-off), and 47.8 Mt Indicated at 0.66% Nb2O5 and 94.4 Mt Inferred at 0.73% Nb2O5 (0.2% Nb2O5 cut-off)², all from surface (historical estimates; not current mineral resources; see “Historical Mineral Resource Estimates” below).
  • Approximately 7% TREO from surface: Historical estimates include higher-grade domains of 11.2 Mt Indicated at 6.93% TREO and 15.6 Mt Inferred at 7.12% TREO at a 5.8% TREO cut-off².
  • Thick high-grade intercepts and open for expansion: Historical drilling returned 105 m at 6.97% TREO from surface, ending in mineralization and including 35 m at 8.50% TREO². Mineralization is open at depth, with rare earth and niobium mineralization reported more than 100 m below surface, and open to the south at the south-eastern margin of the deposit.
  • Rich in high-value magnet metals: Approximately 21% of the historical Indicated TREO is made up of neodymium, dysprosium, europium, terbium and yttrium oxides, with heavy rare earth enrichment relative to typical carbonatite deposits.
  • Coastal location near East Africa’s largest port: Mrima Hill is approximately 60 km by road from the Port of Mombasa and 10 km from the Indian Ocean coast. The project sits near the Mombasa–Lunga Lunga highway, which connects directly to the port.
  • Strategic U.S. critical minerals: Rare earths and niobium are both on the U.S. 2025 List of Critical Minerals. USGS ranks niobium, dysprosium, terbium, yttrium and gadolinium among the highest-risk minerals on that list. Frontier has proposed, subject to confirmation through the feasibility study, to produce separated products refined in Kenya.
  • Fast-track work program: If awarded the licence, Frontier’s 36-month work program will start with twin and confirmation drilling of the historical holes, with the aim of delivering a current NI 43-101 mineral resource within the first year. Expansion drilling, metallurgical test work and the environmental and social impact assessment follow. Frontier is targeting a feasibility study and a development decision within three years of the licence being issued.
  • Refining technology chosen on the evidence: The feasibility study, managed by Bunker Hill, will include a rigorous trade-off study of refining technologies. Subject to its results, ReElement’s chromatography-based separation technology may be used to refine the Project’s rare earths and niobium in Kenya.
  • Dedicated Mrima Hill Team:  Frontier has assembled a project team with experience on carbonatite rare earth and niobium deposits across Africa, Europe and North America. The Bunker Hill Mine team in Idaho will remain fully focused on ramping up to commercial production at the Bunker Hill Mine.
  • Potential U.S. Government funding: Mrima Hill represents a strategic asset to western governments, Frontier holds established and deep relationships within the U.S. government and has been invited to submit an application for grant funding to the U.S. Department of State.

Management Commentary

Richard Williams, Executive Chairman of Bunker Hill, commented: “Mrima Hill is one of the world’s great undeveloped rare earth deposits, and we are proud to have been chosen to help unlock it. In Idaho we are bringing a mine that had been closed for four decades back into production. We along with our consortium partners are bringing that same capability, and a dedicated team, to Kenya, while the Bunker Hill Mine stays fully focused on ramping up to commercial production. This is a defining step in building Bunker Hill into a leading Western supplier of critical minerals.”

Bradley Barnett, CFO of Bunker Hill and Managing Member of Frontier, added: “Kenya ran the first open and competitive mining tender in its history and set a high bar on beneficiation, transparency and community benefit. Frontier proposed a plan to deliver a current resource within a year and a feasibility study within three, and to refine separated rare earth and niobium products in Kenya. We thank Cabinet Secretary Joho, the Ministry and the people of Kwale County for their confidence. We look forward to working with the communities of Kwale County and the Ministry through the licensing process and getting to work.”

Mark C. Jensen, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of American Resources and ReElement Technologies, added: "We are proud to partner with Bunker Hill and Frontier Minerals on this significant opportunity. By combining world-class mining expertise with advanced American refining technologies and integrated critical mineral supply-chain capabilities, we believe we can establish a new model for resource development that enables Kenya to capture greater economic value from its mineral resources while strengthening secure supply chains for the United States and its allies. This selection is not the culmination of our efforts, but the beginning of a long-term partnership focused on responsible development, economic opportunity and shared prosperity."

U.S. Government Support, Strategic Importance and Community Engagement

Frontier is a U.S.-led consortium. Its aim is to build a secure, US-aligned supply of rare earths and niobium. The United States Geological Survey (USGS) ranks niobium, dysprosium, terbium, yttrium and gadolinium among the highest-risk minerals on the U.S. Government’s 2025 list of Critical Minerals. The United States has had no significant niobium mine production since 1959 and imports most of the rare earths it uses. China tightened export controls on rare earth elements in 2025, adding urgency to the search for independent sources. Mrima Hill, with large, high-grade rare earth and niobium mineralization from surface and direct access to a deep-water port, is positioned to become a cornerstone of that supply.

The U.S. Government has made clear its support for developing Kenya’s critical minerals sector. Senior U.S. Department of State officials have publicly backed U.S. participation in the Mrima Hill tender, described the process as transparent, and stated that Washington is ready to help Kenya build a local critical minerals processing industry and become a regional leader in the sector4. Speaking to the American Chamber of Commerce in Kenya in Nairobi on 9 September 2026, Chris Kulukundis, then Acting Deputy Assistant Secretary of State for Southern Africa and Critical Minerals, said: “The Mrima Hill tender process is moving forward in a transparent manner.” Frontier is preparing a full proposal, at the invitation of the U.S. Department of State’s Bureau of African Affairs, under the Department’s publicly announced U.S.-Africa Strategic Investment Program, for Project support. No award has been made, the terms of any award are not known and there is no assurance that funding will be approved.

Bunker Hill and its consortium partners recognize the environmental and cultural significance of Mrima Hill to the Digo community and the people of Kwale County. Working with the Ministry, Frontier intends to engage openly with local communities and stakeholders as the Project advances, and to develop it responsibly and in partnership with the Government of Kenya.

Bunker Hill's Role

Under the proposed development plan submitted through the tender process Bunker Hill will be the mining and processing partner in Frontier if the consortium is awarded the prospecting licence. It will be responsible for exploration and resource definition, mine planning, metallurgical test work, process development and the feasibility study, which it will manage. ReElement and American Resources contribute innovative American refining capabilities and rare earth and critical minerals supply chain relationships. The feasibility study will include a trade-off study of refining technologies, amongst other standard trade-off studies common in a feasibility study of this type. Subject to a positive feasibility study, the grant of a Mining Licence and financing, Bunker Hill is positioned to be contracted by Frontier to build and then operate the mine and processing plant. Bunker Hill also expects to hold an equity interest in Frontier, subject to definitive agreements.

Dedicated Project Team

Frontier has assembled a team built specifically for Mrima Hill, with extensive experience on carbonatite-hosted deposits, including rare earth and niobium deposits, in the United States, Malawi, Tanzania, South Africa and Angola and Finland as well as in rare earth processing and refining technology. Resident positions, including a resource geologist and environmental and community teams, will be recruited in Kenya before the program starts.

Bunker Hill’s leadership will provide strategic oversight. Sam Ash will oversee the mining engineering work, Richard Williams will advise the Steering Committee, and Bradley Barnett will serve on the Steering Committee. The Project will be delivered by its own dedicated team, keeping the Bunker Hill Mine’s management and operating team fully focused on the ramp-up to commercial production in Idaho.

The Mrima Hill Deposit

Mrima Hill is a carbonatite complex located approximately 60 km south-west of Mombasa, capped by a thick residual (laterite) profile enriched in rare earth phosphates and pyrochlore-hosted niobium. The rare earth suite includes the high-value magnet rare earths neodymium, praseodymium, dysprosium and terbium. Because the enrichment is in the residual cap, mineralization starts at surface: 83% of the tonnage in the 2011 historical estimate lay within 20 metres of surface.

The 2013 historical estimates² are modelled over a 1,500 m by 900 m footprint to 250 m depth. Drilling by Pacific Wildcat Resources Corp. (“PAW”) between 2011 and 2013 returned intercepts including 105 m at 6.97% TREO from surface, ending in mineralization and including 35 m at 8.50% TREO, and reported rare earth and niobium mineralization extending more than 100 m below surface. The deposit is open at depth and to the south. Mrima Hill has been ranked among the world’s largest rare earth projects by contained TREO¹, with grades that compare favourably with the few rare earth deposits in production or at feasibility outside China.

Seventy Years of Technical Work

Mrima Hill has been recognized as a rare earth and niobium occurrence since the 1930s, and has drawn sustained interest from major mining companies and government agencies ever since. Between 1955 and 1957, Anglo American completed approximately 1,100 m of drilling, 424 test pits, five prospect shafts and a 172 m adit. Pechiney Saint-Gobain explored the rare earths from 1967 to 1971, processing a 42-tonne bulk sample grading approximately 12% REO through its La Rochelle pilot plant to produce a 23% REO concentrate by grinding and classification alone³. The Geological Survey of Kenya, a Japanese-Kenyan joint venture and the USGS all reported on the deposit between 1959 and 19985. Between 2010 and 2012, PAW drilled 98 holes totaling approximately 7,700 m, 69 of which (5,062 m) support the 2013 historical estimates. PAW also completed the 2011 and 2013 NI 43-101 historical estimates and bench-scale leach test work, and received environmental approval for its project in 2013. Most recently, in 2022, the Government of Kenya completed a geological survey of Mrima Hill.

No pit-shell or other economic constraint was applied. The Company considers the estimates relevant as an indication of the mineralization at Mrima Hill, but their reliability cannot be confirmed until the underlying drilling, sampling, assay and QA/QC data have been obtained and verified. The Company is not aware of any more recent estimate. To verify the historical estimates or upgrade them to current mineral resources, the Company would need to obtain and verify the historical database, re-assay retained material where available, carry out confirmatory and infill drilling and density work, update the geological model, and assess reasonable prospects for eventual economic extraction, including the protected status of the Mrima Hill forest block. A qualified person has not done sufficient work to classify the historical estimates as current mineral resources or mineral reserves, and the Company is not treating them as current mineral resources or mineral reserves. These historical estimates were not prepared under S-K 1300.

Bunker Hill considers these estimates to be relevant as an indication of the scale and grade of the mineralization at Mrima Hill and reliable in that they were prepared by independent qualified persons under NI 43-101 from drilling completed to industry standards at the time. However, a qualified person acting for the consortium has not done sufficient work to classify the historical estimates as current mineral resources or mineral reserves, Bunker Hill is not treating the historical estimates as current mineral resources or mineral reserves, and the historical estimates should not be relied upon. Bunker Hill does not yet have access to the drill-hole database, assay certificates, sample material or drill core supporting the historical estimates. To verify and upgrade the historical estimates to current mineral resources, Bunker Hill would need to obtain and audit the historical data, complete twin and confirmatory drilling with current QA/QC, update the geological model and density data and have an independent qualified person prepare a new estimate, all of which form part of the consortium's planned work program. Bunker Hill is not aware of any more recent mineral resource estimate for Mrima Hill.

Next Steps and Work Program

The Ministry has stated that the award is not a licence. Before any prospecting begins, Frontier must engage openly and respectfully with host communities, landowners, county leadership and local stakeholders and obtain the consents required under Kenya’s Mining Act; apply for a prospecting licence through the Ministry’s Online Mining Cadastre; and have that application reviewed by the Mineral Rights Board, on whose recommendation the Cabinet Secretary grants the licence. Alongside that process, Frontier will also seek access to the historical drill database and core, and start recruiting its in-country team, including a resident resource geologist and environmental and community specialists.

If the Prospecting Licence is issued, Frontier will begin a 36-month work program. The first phase twins and confirms the historical PAW drill holes and is designed to deliver a current NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate within the first year. The second phase will define the broader extent of the deposit. Metallurgical test work and process development will run alongside the drilling, including a planned metallurgical testing and pilot facility in Kenya and the refining technology trade-off study, in which ReElement’s chromatography-based separation technology will be assessed. The program also includes a feasibility study and an environmental, social and health impact assessment (“ESHIA”), with a radiological baseline and radiation safety management plan, and is designed to deliver a development decision within three years of licence issue.

About Bunker Hill Silver Corp.

Bunker Hill Silver Corp. is a U.S.-focused mining company building a modern, long-life operation at its flagship Bunker Hill Mine in northern Idaho’s prolific Silver Valley, complemented by a pipeline of high-grade silver development projects across North America. With production now underway, the Company is advancing the Bunker Hill Mine toward commercial production of zinc, lead and silver concentrates while pursuing opportunities to optimize operations, expand resources and extend mine life.

The Bunker Hill Mine sits in one of North America’s most abundant and storied mining districts and benefits from established infrastructure, a skilled local workforce and a significant mineral resource base. Through its acquisition of Silver47 Exploration Corp., Bunker Hill has added a portfolio of silver-rich projects in Alaska, Nevada and New Mexico, anchoring the Company in America’s most prolific mining jurisdictions.

Bunker Hill’s strategy is focused on disciplined operational execution, responsible mining practices and continued investment in its assets to deliver sustainable production, organic growth and long-term shareholder value.

The EXTEND study is the first clinical trial to evaluate xenotransplantation of a porcine thymokidney in a patient with end-stage renal disease (ESRD)

EXTEND is the second clinical trial in United Therapeutics’ xeno-organ manufacturing program

SILVER SPRING, Md. & RESEARCH TRIANGLE PARK, N.C.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--United Therapeutics Corporation (Nasdaq: UTHR), a public benefit corporation, today announced the first clinical xenotransplant in its EXTEND study of the UThymoKidney™ in patients with ESRD. The transplant operation was performed at NYU Langone Health.

The ongoing EXTEND study will evaluate the safety and efficacy of the UThymoKidney in ESRD patients who are not eligible for conventional allogeneic kidney transplantation or who are on an Organ Procurement and Transplantation Network (OPTN) kidney transplant waitlist, but are more likely to die or go untransplanted within five years than receive a kidney transplant.

United Therapeutics’ investigational UThymoKidney is a xenokidney that contains porcine thymic tissue and is derived from a pig with a single gene edit. The pig’s thymus tissue is intended to condition the recipient’s immune system to recognize the UThymoKidney as “self” and reduce the likelihood of organ rejection. The single gene responsible for the synthesis of alpha-gal, a sugar on the surface of cells that can cause immediate rejection of a porcine organ when transplanted into the human body, has been inactivated in the pig’s genome.

“Today marks an exciting moment for United Therapeutics and for the field of xenotransplantation. EXTEND is the second clinical trial in our xeno-organ manufacturing program, and it reflects years of investment in the science, facilities, and regulatory groundwork needed to bring this technology from possibility to clinical reality,” said Jayme Locke, M.D., Ph.D., Chief Medical Officer, Xenotransplantation at United Therapeutics.

“We are demonstrating that an investigational manufactured organ program can move methodically from the laboratory to patients, always with patient safety first. We are deeply grateful to the participant, their family, and the NYU Langone team,” said Leigh Peterson, Ph.D., Executive Vice President, Product Development & Xenotransplantation at United Therapeutics.

“Every day, people with kidney failure die waiting for an organ that never comes. The need for new sources of organs is urgent. UThymoKidney is designed with the intention to help a recipient’s immune system accept the organ and reduce the risk of organ rejection. The EXTEND study provides a carefully designed, scientifically rigorous way to determine whether another approach to xenotransplantation can deliver real benefit to patients who have few other options,” said Robert Montgomery, M.D., D.Phil., the H. Leon Pachter, M.D., Professor of Surgery; Chair of the Department of Surgery at NYU Grossman School of Medicine; and Director of the NYU Langone Transplant Institute, who led the transplant team that performed the first xenotransplant in the EXTEND study.

About United Therapeutics’ Xenotransplantation Program

United Therapeutics is advancing clinical trials called EXTEND, EXPAND, and EXPRESS, which are intended to support Biologics License Applications (BLA) with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for each of its three investigational xenotransplantation products:

EXTEND (NCT07224763) is a multicenter, open-label, combination phase 1/2/3 clinical trial designed to evaluate the safety and efficacy of UThymoKidney. This phaseless trial will progress without separate phase 1, 2, and 3 studies typically associated with conventional drug approvals.

Study participants will receive a UThymoKidney transplant followed by a 24-week post-transplant follow-up period, including the evaluation of all study endpoints and safety assessments. After the 24-week post-transplant follow-up period, participants who receive a UThymoKidney will continue to be followed for the rest of their lives, including monitoring for UThymoKidney function and zoonotic infections.

Efficacy endpoints include participant survival rate, UThymoKidney survival rate, change in measured glomerular filtration rate1, donor specific hyporesponsiveness2, and change in quality of life3 in participants at 24 weeks post-transplant, as well as overall survival time of participants receiving a UThymoKidney and overall survival time of the UThymoKidney post-transplant. Safety endpoints include the incidence of adverse events and serious adverse events, all-cause mortality, and the incidence of proteinuria4, zoonotic infections, and opportunistic infections5.

The first six transplants will take place at two centers, with a 12-week waiting period between the first and second transplants. After all six participants reach at least 12 weeks post-transplant, safety and efficacy data will be reviewed by an Independent Data Monitoring Committee to determine if the study should continue. United Therapeutics intends to present the data from the first six transplants to the FDA for review prior to including additional transplant centers and increasing the study sample size to support a BLA. Additional details on the EXTEND study, including full inclusion and exclusion criteria, are available at ClinicalTrials.gov.

EXPAND (NCT06878560) is a multicenter, open-label, safety and efficacy study of United Therapeutics’ UKidney™ in patients with ESRD. The EXPAND study is currently being conducted at NYU Langone Health and Northwestern Medicine, with the potential to include other centers if initial data are supportive. EXPAND is the world’s first clinical trial designed specifically to generate the definitive safety and efficacy data needed to support an application for regulatory approval (i.e., a registration study).

EXPRESS is an open-label, safety and efficacy study of United Therapeutics’ UHeart™ in patients with advanced heart failure. It will start at a single center with potential to include other centers if initial data are supportive.

The UThymoKidney is a xenokidney that contains porcine thymic tissue and is derived from a pig with a single gene edit.

The UKidney and UHeart are derived from a pig with 10 gene edits. Six human genes are added to the pig genome to facilitate immunological acceptance and compatibility of the organ in the human recipient. Four porcine genes are inactivated or “knocked out” to reduce the risk of organ rejection and to moderate organ growth.

United Therapeutics' xeno-organs are all investigational-stage products which have not been approved in any jurisdiction for any indication.

The Organ Shortage Crisis and ESRD

Demand for organ transplants far exceeds the supply of available organs, and alternative organ sources are needed. In the United States alone, there are approximately 830,000 patients with kidney failure, over 550,000 patients on dialysis, and more than 90,000 patients on the kidney transplant waiting list. Only about 22,000 deceased donor kidney transplants occurred in 20256. The 2024 US Renal Data System Annual Report found that, three years after starting dialysis, only 12% of patients had been placed on an OPTN kidney transplant waitlist and more than 40% had died without receiving a kidney transplant7. Xenotransplantation offers the potential to mitigate, and perhaps even solve, the organ shortage crisis.

About United Therapeutics

Founded by CEO Martine Rothblatt to discover a cure for her daughter's life-threatening rare disease, pulmonary arterial hypertension, United Therapeutics transforms the treatment of rare diseases and pioneers alternatives to expand the supply of transplantable organs. From our innovative therapies to our groundbreaking manufactured organs, we are bold and unconventional. We move quickly from scientific theory to practical technologies that can save lives. As a public benefit corporation, even our legal structure reflects our commitments. We serve patients, act with integrity, create long-term shareholder value, and operate with sustainable practices that protect the future we are working to build. Key Terms

esrdmedical
End-stage renal disease (ESRD) is the final, irreversible stage of chronic kidney failure when the kidneys can no longer sustain the body's fluid, electrolyte and waste balance on their own. It is typically defined clinically by very low kidney function (often an estimated glomerular filtration rate below about 15 mL/min/1.73 m²) or by the need for long-term renal replacement therapy such as dialysis or kidney transplantation. ESRD describes a medical state, not a specific diagnosis or treatment, and signals that ongoing dialysis or a transplant will be required to replace lost kidney function.
xenotransplantationmedical
Transplanting organs, tissues, or cells from one species into a human, most often using genetically modified animals as donors. Investors watch this area because successful xenotransplantation could create large new markets for treating organ failure but also faces steep scientific, regulatory, ethical and reimbursement hurdles—think of fitting a part from a different-model car: if it works it can extend life and value, but compatibility and approval risks are high.
allogeneic kidney transplantationmedical
Surgical replacement of a failing kidney using a kidney donated by another person whose tissue is not genetically identical to the recipient; the donor can be living or deceased. Successful allogeneic transplantation requires blood‑type and tissue‑matching tests and ongoing immunosuppressive drugs to prevent the recipient’s immune system from rejecting the graft, which creates long‑term tradeoffs such as infection risk and the possibility of chronic rejection. It is distinct from autologous transplantation (using the patient’s own tissue) and syngeneic transplantation (from an identical twin).
open-labeltechnical
Open-label describes a situation where everyone involved in a study or process knows the full details, such as who is receiving a treatment or intervention. For investors, understanding whether a project or product is open-label helps gauge the level of transparency and potential biases, influencing trust and decision-making. It’s like knowing whether a test or experiment is conducted openly or behind closed doors.
biologics license applicationsregulatory
A biologics license application is a formal request submitted to a regulatory agency to get permission to market a biological medicine—such as vaccines, blood products, or gene and cell therapies—after clinical testing. It’s like applying for a safety and quality permit that lets a company sell a complex medical product; investors watch its progress because approval clears the way for revenue while rejection or delays create significant financial risk.
zoonotic infectionsmedical
Zoonotic infections are illnesses that jump from animals to people, caused by bacteria, viruses, or parasites that normally live in nonhuman hosts. They matter to investors because outbreaks can quickly change demand for medical products, disrupt agriculture, travel and supply chains, and trigger new regulations or vaccine and testing spending—similar to a fire in one building that forces nearby businesses to change how they operate and spend.

Just in Time for Holiday Shopping & Consigning

The RealReal's third LA store offers personalized luxury consignment services, expert valuations and a constantly evolving assortment of one-of-one designer fashion, handbags, jewelry and watches

GLENDALE, Calif., Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- The RealReal (Nasdaq: REAL), the world's largest online marketplace for authenticated luxury resale, today announced the official opening of its newest Los Angeles-area store at The Americana at Brand located at 230 S Brand Blvd in Glendale, California. The location expands The RealReal's Southern California presence, bringing its full-service luxury consignment and shopping experience to one of the region's premier shopping destinations.

The Glendale store offers customers the opportunity to shop and consign authenticated luxury in one location, with a curated, constantly evolving assortment of designer fashion, handbags, fine jewelry, watches and accessories. Shoppers can discover one-of-one pieces from sought-after luxury houses including Chanel, Hermès, Louis Vuitton, Dior, Gucci, The Row, Cartier and Rolex, while consignors can meet with luxury experts to learn more about the value of items in their closets.

"Glendale is a natural fit for The RealReal, with a community that appreciates great style, quality craftsmanship and the value of luxury," said Rati Sahi Levesque, President & CEO, The RealReal. "We wanted to make it incredibly easy for customers in Glendale and surrounding communities to give the pieces they no longer wear a second life. Our trained in-store experts handle the entire consignment process. And, we have a constantly changing assortment of one-of-a-kind luxury pieces, so there's something new to discover with every visit!"

The opening comes as consumers increasingly embrace resale as an integral part of luxury shopping. According to The RealReal's 2026 Resale Report, demand for vintage has increased 432% since 2020, while searches for 2000s fashion have risen 93% year over year. More than half of The RealReal's customer base is now Gen Z and Millennials, reflecting a growing appetite for unique pieces, fashion history and individual expression.

The Glendale store offers:

  • Personalized Consignment Services: One-on-one consultations with luxury experts to help customers sell designer fashion, handbags, fine jewelry, watches and accessories.
  • Luxury Expertise & Valuations: Expert evaluations and insights into resale value and market demand.
  • Curated Luxury Shopping: A regularly refreshed assortment of authenticated, one-of-one pieces spanning iconic designers, vintage fashion and hard-to-find luxury.
  • Private Luxury Appointments: Personalized appointments for customers interested in exceptional fine jewelry, watches, rare handbags and other high-value pieces.
  • Special Offer: $100 credit to shop in-store when you consign at least one accepted item. Site credit is valid in-store, same-day only. Ask store associates for details.

The new store joins The RealReal's existing Southern California locations on Melrose Avenue and in Brentwood, Los Angeles, as well as Newport Beach, further expanding access to authenticated luxury resale and personalized consignment services across the region.

About The RealReal
The RealReal is the world's largest online marketplace for authenticated resale luxury goods, trusted by a community of 45 million members. Its full-service consignment model across fashion, fine jewelry and watches, art and home, makes it easy for customers to buy and sell luxury wherever they are. The company combines rigorous, expert-led authentication with AI and proprietary technology to optimize operations and pricing while streamlining the customer experience. Backed by 15 years of proprietary data and more than 55 million items sold, The RealReal has become the preferred destination for modern luxury resale, redefining the luxury lifecycle.

About The Americana at Brand
Caruso's The Americana at Brand fuses unparalleled retail, dining and entertainment experiences, luxury apartments and stunning landscaping to create one of Southern California's most distinctive urban destinations. The iconic property, which celebrated its 18th year, is built around a grand two-acre green, replete with a choreographed dancing water fountain and a historic orange trolley transporting guests around the property. This dynamic setting attracts the world's finest and most successful retailers including Nordstrom, David Yurman, Tiffany & Co. and Apple, whose locations at The Americana at Brand are often among the best performing in their portfolios. Sophisticated living defines The Americana at Brand Luxury Apartments, where nearly 250 apartments are poised atop the retail spaces, and residents enjoy unparalleled amenities, services from a world-class concierge team and access to the best offerings from The Americana at Brand and beyond. For more information, please visit The Americana at Brand at americanaatbrand.com or on Instagram @AmericanaBrand.

Today, November 20, 2026: Hotel101 Global signs definitive binding agreements for the development of Hotel101-Johor Bahru, Malaysia

Hotel101-Johor Bahru is set to have approx. 606 rooms on a 3,535 sqm site located on the corner of Jalan Tun Abdul Razak and the Johor Bahru Inner Ring Road, only around 2 minutes from the Bukit Chagar RTS Link Station, the key hub of the Johor Bahru-Singapore RTS Link

SINGAPORE, Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Hotel101 Global Holdings Corp. (NASDAQ Ticker: HBNB) (“Hotel101” or “Hotel101 Global”), a leading asset-light, prop-tech hospitality platform pioneering a globally standardized “condotel” business model, listed on the Nasdaq Stock Exchange and a subsidiary of Philippine-listed DoubleDragon Corporation (PSE Ticker: DD), announces the signing of definitive binding agreements for the development of an approx. 606-room Hotel101-Johor Bahru, Malaysia.

Hotel101 Global Team believes it ensures all its projects via direct developments, joint ventures and licensing to local developers in various countries worldwide are in prime and strategic locations.

The project situated at the Flagship A of Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone (JS-SEZ). JS-SEZ is a cross-border economic partnership between Malaysia and Singapore, established via bilateral agreement in January 2025, that pairs Johor's land, resources, and cost-competitive manufacturing capacity with Singapore's capital, financial services, and global connectivity. Spanning roughly 3,500 square kilometers across southern Johor with flagship zones and promoted sectors ranging from digital economy, manufacturing, and logistics to green energy and services, the zone offers tailored incentives, streamlined approvals, and improved cross-border movement to attract high-value investment and create skilled jobs.

The hotel, to be named Hotel101-Johor Bahru, is planned to occupy a prime site on the corner of Jalan Tun Abdul Razak and the Johor Bahru Inner Ring Road in the heart of Johor Bahru’s central business district. This strategic position is expected to offer guests excellent connectivity, sitting only around two minutes from the Bukit Chagar RTS Link Station—the key Malaysian hub of the Johor Bahru-Singapore RTS Link that is expected to connect directly to Woodlands North in Singapore in around five minutes. The area has rapidly emerged as one of Johor’s key growth districts, known for its modern infrastructure, improving transport links, and strong mix of residential, commercial, and tourism developments, while sitting at the centre of one of the world’s busiest land border crossings.

Key Location Advantages:

  • Prime Jalan Tun Abdul Razak Position: Located at the corner of Jalan Tun Abdul Razak and the Johor Bahru Inner Ring Road with direct access to the city’s main arterial routes. Upon completion, guests are expected to benefit from outstanding road connectivity and proximity to the upcoming RTS Link.

  • Proximity to Major Attractions and Connectivity: Situated within the Johor Bahru CBD that is expected to be served by the upcoming RTS Link, JB Sentral, major shopping malls, and the wider cross-border market. The site is expected to offer a balance of modern urban development and strong cross-border demand, with easy access to key commercial amenities, residential communities, and the reported 430,000–450,000 daily travellers moving between Malaysia and Singapore.

When completed, Hotel101-Johor Bahru is expected to generate approx. MYR275.73 million (US$66.78 million) in sales revenue once fully sold and is expected to be the largest hotel by room count in Johor Bahru, Malaysia, forming part of Hotel101 Global’s global expansion strategy.

Hotel101-Johor Bahru is expected to offer 4-star amenities at affordable prices, including a ballroom, ample meeting spaces, and a conference center tailored for business events. Consistent with Hotel101’s offerings across its locations globally, guests are expected to enjoy modern rooms, 24/7 reception, all-day dining, swimming pools, a full-size gym, a business center, children’s playground, ample parking, luggage storage, and other amenities.

The development is subject to customary governmental, regulatory, corporate and other approvals.

About Hotel101 Global

Listed on Nasdaq (Ticker: HBNB) with a market capitalization of approx. US$1 billion as of November 18, 2026, Hotel101 is an asset-light, prop-tech hospitality platform pioneering a globally standardized “condotel” business model. Hotel101 aims to disrupt the global hotel and hospitality sector through its unique tech-enabled business model that positions it to generate revenues twice: first from the advance sale of individual hotel units during the construction phase; and second, from long-term recurring revenue derived from day-to-day hotel operations. The expansion of Hotel101 toward its long-term goal to operate in 100 countries globally is expected to be driven mainly by joint ventures and, in the future, license agreements with local developers in various countries worldwide.

The Hotel101 Global Group is advancing its global expansion plans toward its medium-term goal to be in 25 countries and its long-term goal of operating one million Hotel101 rooms in 100 countries globally.

DURHAM, N.C.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Precision BioSciences, Inc. (Nasdaq: DTIL), a clinical stage gene editing company utilizing its novel proprietary ARCUS® platform to develop in vivo gene editing therapies for high unmet need diseases, today announced that, on November 16, 2026, the Compensation Committee of Precision’s Board of Directors approved the grant of inducement awards to new employees under the Precision BioSciences, Inc. 2021 Employment Inducement Incentive Award Plan (“Inducement Award Plan”). The inducement awards consist of an aggregate total of 39,146 restricted stock units (“RSUs”), granted among five employees in connection with their commencement of employment. Each award was granted under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4) as an inducement for the employee to commence service with Precision.

The employees’ RSUs vest (subject to continued service to Precision through the applicable vesting dates) in substantially equal annual installments on each of the first three anniversaries of the date of the commencement of their employment.

About Precision BioSciences, Inc.

Precision BioSciences, Inc. is a clinical stage gene editing company dedicated to improving life (DTIL) with its novel and proprietary ARCUS® genome editing platform that differs from other technologies in the way it cuts, its smaller size, and its simpler structure. These features are intended for ARCUS nucleases to drive more defined therapeutic outcomes. Using ARCUS, the Company’s pipeline is comprised of clinical stage in vivo gene editing candidates designed to deliver lasting cures for the broadest range of genetic and infectious diseases where no adequate treatments exist. For more information about Precision BioSciences, please visit www.precisionbiosciences.com.

The ARCUS® platform is being used to develop in vivo gene editing therapies for sophisticated gene edits, including gene elimination (removing a viral genome e.g. viral DNA such as in the Company’s PBGENE-HBV program), and excision (removing a large portion of a defective gene by delivering two ARCUS nucleases in a single AAV such as in the Company’s PBGENE-DMD program) and gene insertion (inserting DNA into a gene to cause expression or add function).

Key Terms

restricted stock unitsfinancial
Restricted stock units are a type of company reward where employees are promised shares of stock, but they only fully own these shares after meeting certain conditions, like staying with the company for a set time. They matter because they can become valuable assets and are often used to motivate employees to help the company succeed.
nasdaq listing rule 5635(c)(4)regulatory
NASDAQ Listing Rule 5635(c)(4) is a rule that requires a company to get approval from its shareholders before selling a large amount of its shares, usually over 20%. This helps protect investors by making sure the company doesn't flood the market with new shares without their say, which could lower the stock's value.

Funded lease contract growth continued to accelerate in Q3 2026, with an increase of 80% in the value of contracts financed over Q2

Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 20, 2026) - AmeriTrust Financial Technologies Inc. (TSXV: AMT) (OTCQB: AMTFF) (FSE: 1ZV) ("AmeriTrust", "AMT" or the "Company"), a fintech platform focused on automotive finance, today announced its financial results for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026. The Company's unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements and Management's Discussion and Analysis ("MD&A") for the period are available under the Company's profile on SEDAR+. All amounts are expressed in Canadian dollars unless otherwise stated.

Third Quarter 2026 Highlights

To view an enhanced version of this graphic, please visit:
https://images.newsfilecorp.com/files/12485/324982_ameritrusttable.jpg

EBITDA and Adjusted EBITDA are non-IFRS measures. See "Non-IFRS Measures" below.

  • Revenue of $1,104,979, up 169% from $411,257 in Q3 2025 and up 25% from $885,065 in Q2 2026, with revenue growing in each successive quarter of 2026.

  • Gross profit of $389,197, up 113% from $182,880 in Q3 2025 and up 42% from $273,157 in Q2 2026.

  • Net loss of $4,202,109 (Q3 2025 – $2,988,439), primarily reflecting front loaded expenses related to accelerated sales hiring designed to drive dealer relationships, applications and originations in the coming quarters, higher bank related fees from increased usage of the Company's Bank of Texas facility, and increased legal expenses associated with initiatives including long-term funding transactions that are in active discussions.

  • Adjusted EBITDA loss (a non-IFRS measure) of $2,081,214, narrowing for the second consecutive quarter and down 6.6% from Q2 2026.

  • During the third quarter of 2026 AmeriTrust received 2,221 applications representing approximately $114.2 million in potential funding opportunities, approved or conditionally approved 572 consumer applications, and funded 99 lease contracts.

  • The fourth quarter of 2026 began strongly, with October 2026 application volume reaching an annualized run-rate of approximately $525 million, roughly 3 times the dollar volume of applications received for the year-to-date period through September 2026.

  • Approvals continue to improve with a materially higher percentage of total applications submitted being approved, reflecting an improved application pool.

  • The dollar volume of October 2026 approvals increased to more than $225 million on an annualized run-rate basis, which provides some indication for potential originations and growth over time with normalized financing facilities.

  • Cash and cash equivalents of $66.7 million and working capital of $47.1 million at September 30, 2026.

"The third quarter shows our model continues to perform," said Jeff Morgan, Chief Executive Officer of AmeriTrust. "Since we restarted lease originations at the beginning of the year, revenue has grown every quarter. Third-quarter revenue increased more than 25% from the second quarter and was 2.5 times the level of a year ago. Funded volumes rose in every month of the quarter, and we did it without compromising credit quality. Customers funded in the quarter had a weighted average FICO score of 713, a weighted average contract rate of 8.71%, and a weighted average net capitalized cost of $91,222.

"The leases we have funded this year carry approximately $11.3 million of contractual cash flows, which are expected to be earned over their life of lease. That gives us a growing base of recurring revenue that builds quarter after quarter.

"We are also beginning to see operating leverage in our platform. Adjusted EBITDA loss narrowed for the second consecutive quarter, even as we continued to invest in the people and systems needed to scale nationally. Application and approval volumes have grown, and their quality has improved in recent months. The sales associates we recently added should strengthen those trends further. When we finalize the long-term funding facilities we are pursuing, we expect originations to increase meaningfully in 2027. With $66.7 million in cash and cash equivalents, we are well capitalized to execute our growth plan. I want to thank our employees, our dealers, and our shareholders for their continued support."

The Company also announces that on October 1, 2026, it granted 3,125,000 restricted share units ("RSUs") to a director and officer of the Company. The grant was made under the Company's Incentive Stock Option Plan (20% Fixed Plan) / Restricted Share Unit plan, which was most recently approved by shareholders on June 24, 2026. The RSU's will vest on October 1, 2027.

About AmeriTrust Financial Technologies Inc.

AmeriTrust Financial Technologies Inc., listed on the TSX Venture Exchange, OTCQB, and Frankfurt markets, is a finance solution and fintech provider disrupting the automotive industry. Through its AmeriTrust Financial, AmeriTrust Serves and AmeriTrust Auto divisions, the Company originates and funds vehicle leases, services lease portfolios, and sells vehicles and related products in the United States. AmeriTrust's integrated, cloud-based transaction platform facilitates transactions amongst consumers, dealers, and funders. AmeriTrust's platform is being made available across the United States.

Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 20, 2026) - Intrepid Metals Corp. (TSXV: INTR) (OTCQB: IMTCF) ("Intrepid" or the "Company") is pleased to provide an update on its ongoing 10,000-metre drill program and integrated exploration activities at the Corral Copper Project ("Corral" or the "Project"), located in Cochise County, Arizona. More than 3,100 metres of drilling have been completed in seven step-out holes, and the Company's geophysics survey is nearing completion to support upcoming tests of deeper carbonate replacement deposit ("CRD") and porphyry copper targets. Ivanhoe Electric Inc.'s ("Ivanhoe Electric") recently announced copper-gold discovery at its adjacent Gleeson Copper Project ("Gleeson"), immediately west of Corral, further highlights the district's exploration potential (please refer to Ivanhoe Electric's news release dated November 19, 2026)1,2.

"The Intrepid team continues to make steady progress at Corral, with over 3,100 metres completed in 7 step-out drill holes at the Holliday and Ringo Zones," said Matt Lennox-King, Chairman and Interim CEO of Intrepid. "The extensive IP & MT survey is nearing completion and will be a key targeting tool as we progress through the remaining ~7,000 metres of the drill program at Corral. As the program progresses, we will be testing new deeper CRD targets and porphyry copper targets for the first time."

"We would also like to congratulate our neighbour, Ivanhoe Electric, on their Gleeson copper-gold discovery announced yesterday, which we view as a game changer for the wider district," continued Mr. Lennox-King. "The Gleeson discovery is located just roughly 150 metres west of our Project boundary and reportedly bears strong similarities in copper and gold grades, host rocks and geologic setting to our Holliday, Earp, Ringo and Clanton Zones. Our Curly Porphyry Target (please refer to Intrepid's news release dated July 14, 2026 titled "Intrepid Metals Identifies New Porphyry Target at Corral Copper" for details about the Curly Target) sits immediately east of Ivanhoe Electric's Gleeson discovery drill holes and we look forward to drilling at Curly as part of the current program."

Exploration Highlights:

  • Drilling: Approximately 3,100 metres of step-out drilling has been completed at the Holliday and Ringo Zones in 7 drill holes targeting extensions to the previously drilled high-grade copper gold mineralization.

  • Geophysics: The induced polarization ("IP") and Magnetotelluric ("MT") survey which began in mid-September is nearing completion. The survey covers the northern 75% of the Project and the results of the survey will be a key targeting tool for the remainder of the program.

  • Surface Work Defines New Targets: Ongoing geological mapping, rock and soil sampling, and portable X-ray fluorescence ("pXRF") analysis of fracture-fill material have helped define and advance key new target areas including Curly, Kate, and Mattie, each of which is a priority area for drilling.
